name: toolkit
description: Tool-specific CLI guidance for Apple container and Git workflows, including opt-in git-codex alias and message-file lifecycle automation.

interface.shortDescription: Operate Apple container and bounded Git workflows.
interface.longDescription: Provides bounded skills for Apple container lifecycle and task-scoped Git commit, branch, push, recovery, managed git-codex alias maintenance, and opt-in heredoc input with automatic validation and repository-local message IDs.
defaultPrompt: Use $toolkit:apple-container for Apple container CLI tasks on Apple silicon macOS, including common commands, lifecycle checks, compatibility limits, installation, uninstallation, containerization concepts, and the bundled experimental k8s plugin without assuming third-party Kubernetes CLI execution.

Use $toolkit:git for task-scoped commits with risk-proportional checks, message hygiene, one related change unit, a typed subject under 120 characters, and stored full-message verification; prefer git-codex message create --stdin with a quoted heredoc, automatic validation, and short MSG IDs in the current Git directory. It also covers explicitly requested alias.codex install, uninstall, and doctor, branch creation or switching, explicit git switch -C, upstream and refspec pushes, branch policy, and recovery. Use clear command results directly and query additional state only for incorrect invocations or uncertain outcomes.
